nodes.label: Causality test failure (gLN global normalization)
nodes.rationale: Zeroing the last 5 s changed the first second of output by 20.17% relative L2; Asteroid gLN normalizes across time, so the full-clip model is non-causal and chunking cannot restore the paper model.

nodes.label: Raw output scaling / clipping finding
nodes.rationale: Raw output peak 29.04, RMS 4.08; ~38% of samples exceed [-1,1]. Bundled demo result matches a clipped version of the raw output, so it is not a clean target and cannot establish accuracy.

nodes.label: Differences from original SpeakerBeam-SS paper
nodes.rationale: Uses separately pretrained Resemblyzer embeddings instead of a jointly trained encoder, gLN instead of channel-wise norm, different block/dilation layout, S4D FF width 256, FFT convolution without carried state, 4096-ch frontend.

nodes.label: Checkpoint weight licensing/provenance blocker

nodes.norm_label: carried band_rnn lstm state across chunks
nodes.rationale: Only STFT, time LSTM and iSTFT depend on time; carrying LSTM state and streaming STFT/iSTFT gives output identical to whole-clip forward with 32 ms algorithmic latency.

nodes.label: Kaldi fbank dither (source of apparent causality leak)
nodes.norm_label: kaldi fbank dither (source of apparent causality leak)
nodes.rationale: Dither 1.0 at inference added random noise (~0.2% of peak), which was misreported as a causality leak; with dither off the model is strictly causal and deterministic.

nodes.label: Chunk size and safety margin trade-off
nodes.norm_label: chunk size and safety margin trade-off
nodes.rationale: Margin must cover 20 ms mic-block arrival, ~35 ms compute per 64 ms chunk and 24 ms iSTFT start-up lag; smaller margins underran. Default 64 ms chunk, 0.10 s margin gives ~167 ms delay.

nodes.label: Crash safety (atomic last.pt/prev.pt, resume, divergence stop)
nodes.norm_label: crash safety (atomic last.pt/prev.pt, resume, divergence stop)
nodes.rationale: Crash, reboot or power loss costs at most ~10 minutes; atomic rename prevents half-written checkpoints; 20 non-finite batches in a row stop training without saving bad weights.

nodes.label: numpy<2 constraint
nodes.rationale: WeSep/WeSpeaker are not numpy-2 ready.

nodes.label: Separate-recording enrollment channel mismatch
nodes.rationale: Separate recordings came from a different session/microphone and training used discovered-style enrollments 60% of the time, so R1 is weaker with clean other-session enrollment; R2 should add channel augmentation.
